description: This file contains the implementation of a builder class 'ImmutableSearchResultBuilder' for constructing instances of 'ImmutableSearchResult'. It provides a fluent API for assembling JSON-based search results, including features like setting pagination offsets and cursors, and initializing from existing search results.

classes.name: ImmutableSearchResultBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class implementing a fluent API to construct 'ImmutableSearchResult' objects by aggregating JSON values, managing pagination data like offset and cursor, and enabling initialization from existing search result instances.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance with default pagination settings, starting with an empty JSON array.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a builder initialized with data from an existing 'SearchResult', including items, offset, and cursor.

methods.name: nextPageOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset for the next page of search results.

methods.name: cursor
methods.description: Sets the cursor for the search result pagination.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds one or more JSON values to the internal JSON array.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds all JSON values from an iterable to the internal JSON array.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a JSON value from the internal JSON array.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns an 'ImmutableSearchResult' using the accumulated JSON array, offset, and cursor.
